g.text: Serving one Region vs training the model
Same racks, very different shapes of work
each replica = enough chips to hold
the weights + KV cache (a rack or part)
every chip works on the same model
needs the fastest fabric between all chips
weeks to months · checkpoints to storage
(human or AI feedback, tests) → gradient step
the update step needs a training cluster
runs again for every model version
1 rack ≈ 120 kW → one Region's inference fleet: megawatts (illustrative) → Project Rainier at full build: 2.2 GW ≈ 18,000 racks' worth of power
Your ap-southeast-2 traffic only ever touches the left column. Training happens elsewhere and ships a checkpoint (slide C2).
